scheme_name: Nirman Shramik Avm Unke Aashrit Bacchon Dwara Bhartiya Rajasthan Prashasnik Seva Hetu Aayojit Pratibhabhik Yojana
description:
The Nirman Shramik Avm Unke Aashrit Bacchon Dwara Bhartiya Rajasthan Prashasnik Seva Hetu Aayojit Pratibhabhik Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Rajasthan.

This scheme was launched on 1st April 2021.

It aims to provide educational support to the children of construction workers in Rajasthan.

The primary objective of this scheme is to ensure that children of construction workers receive quality education.

The scheme specifically targets children from economically weaker sections of society.

The government has set a measurable target to enroll at least 10,000 children under this scheme in the first year.

The scheme also aims to provide scholarships to eligible students.

These scholarships can amount up to INR 25,000 per annum.

The financial assistance is intended to cover educational expenses such as tuition fees, books, and other necessary materials.

Eligibility for this scheme is primarily based on the parent's occupation.

Only children of registered construction workers are eligible for this scheme.

The construction workers must be registered with the Rajasthan Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

To qualify, the construction worker must have a valid registration number.

There are no specific age limits mentioned for the children.

However, the children must be enrolled in recognized educational institutions.

The application process for this scheme is straightforward.

Interested applicants must fill out the application form available on the official website of the Rajasthan Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

The application form requires details such as the construction worker's registration number, personal details, and educational details of the child.

Applicants must also submit supporting documents.

These documents include a copy of the construction worker's registration certificate.

Additionally, a copy of the child's birth certificate is required.

Proof of enrollment in an educational institution must also be submitted.

The application can be submitted online through the official portal.

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities.

The review process typically takes about 30 days.

Eligible applicants will receive a notification regarding the approval of their application.

Disbursement of funds is done directly to the bank account of the beneficiary.

The scholarship amount is disbursed annually.

The first disbursement for the approved applicants is expected to occur by the end of the academic year.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Rajasthan Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

This board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Government of Rajasthan.

For any queries or assistance, beneficiaries can contact the board at their official helpline number.

The helpline number is available on the official website.

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of education for the children of construction workers.

It aims to break the cycle of poverty by providing educational opportunities.

The government has allocated a budget of INR 50 crores for the initial phase of this scheme.

This budget is intended to support the enrollment and scholarship of the targeted number of children.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to uplift the socio-economic status of construction workers in Rajasthan.

The government recognizes the significant contribution of construction workers to the state's economy.

By providing educational support, the scheme aims to empower the next generation.

The scheme also aligns with the national goals of improving literacy rates and educational attainment.

The Rajasthan government has been proactive in implementing various welfare schemes for marginalized sections of society.

This initiative is a step towards ensuring that no child is left behind in accessing quality education.

The scheme is expected to have a positive impact on the overall educational landscape in Rajasthan.

It aims to foster a sense of security and hope among construction workers regarding their children's future.

The government plans to monitor the progress of the scheme regularly.

Feedback from beneficiaries will be collected to improve the scheme further.

The scheme is expected to be reviewed annually to assess its effectiveness.

The Rajasthan government is committed to making education accessible for all.

This scheme is a testament to that commitment.

In conclusion, the Nirman Shramik Avm Unke Aashrit Bacchon Dwara Bhartiya Rajasthan Prashasnik Seva Hetu Aayojit Pratibhabhik Yojana is a significant step towards ensuring educational support for the children of construction workers in Rajasthan.

It provides a structured approach to assist families in need.

The scheme is designed to uplift the socio-economic conditions of construction workers through education.

The government encourages all eligible families to take advantage of this initiative.

By doing so, they can secure a better future for their children.
